dataset_split_details.limitation_disclosure: Evaluated only on held-out records. No synthetic samples manufactured.

metric_definitions.top1_accuracy: Fraction of fault cases where the top-ranked candidate link matches the ground truth label.
metric_definitions.top3_accuracy: Fraction of fault cases where the ground truth label appears within the top 3 ranked candidates.
metric_definitions.mean_reciprocal_rank: Mean of the reciprocal ranks (1/rank) of the ground truth label across all fault cases (0 if not in ranked candidates).
metric_definitions.selective_accuracy: Accuracy evaluated strictly on runs where the engine issued a confident diagnosis without abstaining.
metric_definitions.abstention_coverage: Fraction of evaluated runs where the engine issued a diagnosis rather than abstaining.
metric_definitions.false_confident_diagnosis_rate: Fraction of non-abstained diagnoses where the top-ranked prediction was incorrect.
metric_definitions.unsupported_abstention_accuracy: Fraction of healthy / unsupported runs where the engine correctly abstained.
metric_definitions.unsupported_conclusion_rate: Fraction of healthy / unsupported runs where the engine falsely issued a fault conclusion.

note: Metrics are calculated only from supplied held-out labels; this tool does not establish dataset quality or generalize beyond it.
